title: Prism Attention: Proposal-Refined Index Sharing Mechanism for Efficient LLMs Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.22985v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-context decoding in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by the memory and computation required to attend over an ever-growing Key-Value (KV) cache at each autoregressive step. Although token-level sparse attention reduces this burden by restricting computation to a small subset of relevant past tokens, its practical gains are often offset by repeatedly recomputing layer-wise sparse indices as the context grows. A common remedy is to share sparse indices across layers by computing them only at designated anchor layers, but such static reuse ignores the layer-wise evolution of attention patterns, causing the reused indices to progressively deviate from the layer-specific optima and incur substantial attention loss. translated_title: Prism注意力：面向高效大语言模型推理的提案精细化索引共享机制
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）中的长上下文解码日益受到每一步自回归生成时对不断增长的键值（KV）缓存进行注意力计算所需的内存与计算量的瓶颈制约。尽管令牌级稀疏注意力通过将计算限制在少量相关的历史令牌上来减轻这一负担，但其实际收益往往因上下文增长时需要反复重新计算各层稀疏索引而被抵消。一种常见的补救措施是仅在指定的锚点层计算稀疏索引并跨层共享，但这种静态复用方式忽略了注意力模式随层的演化，导致复用的索引逐渐偏离各层的最优选择，造成显著的注意力损失。通过从注意力动态的视角重新审视跨层稀疏性，我们发现层间显著令牌的偏移具有高度局部性：尽管精确的 top-$\kappa$ 索引在各层之间有所不同……
tldr: 提出Prism Attention机制，利用层间显著令牌偏移高度局部化的特性，以“提案-精细化”的方式在层间共享并修正稀疏注意力索引，在避免静态索引复用导致注意力损失的同时，大幅提升大语言模型长上下文推理效率。
en_tdlr: Prism Attention exploits the high locality of inter-layer salient token shifts to share sparse attention indices across layers via a proposal-refinement mechanism, avoiding the attention loss of static index reuse and enabling efficient long-context LLM inference.
